card.name: Swallow in ability-to-swallow tablets
card.fires_on: The word swallow (or its start, Sw-allow) right after phrases like "able to", "unable to" or "ability to", mostly about swallowing tablets or capsules in pediatric dosing.

modes.label: After able/unable to
modes.description: The verb swallow follows a phrase about whether a patient can swallow a tablet or capsule.
modes.example: pediatric patients should be assessed for the ability to<< swallow>> tablets.

modes.label: Swallow split or as instruction
modes.description: The word is split as Sw-allow, or appears as a direct instruction to swallow tablets whole.
modes.example: Sw<<allow>> a Tablet The recommended oral dosage of em
